profile:
COMPANY NAME: Unity
INDUSTRY: Game Development / Interactive Software
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: A leading cross-platform game engine and development suite for creating 2D and 3D games, XR experiences, and interactive applications, supported by tools for deployment, live operations, and monetization.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Game developers (indie to AAA), studios, educational institutions, and enterprises in industries such as manufacturing, retail, automotive, and simulation.
PRICING MODEL: Freemium / Tiered Subscription
KEY FEATURES:
- Cross-platform support for 25+ devices including mobile, desktop, console, and XR
- Integrated LiveOps tools for post-launch insights and game operations
- Monetization and user acquisition services including in-app purchase management and advertising
- Real-time 3D collaboration and immersive training capabilities
- Extensive ecosystem including Unity Cloud, AI tools, and a global developer community
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: The world's leading game engine with the most successful game development community in history; data-informed decision making based on player preferences; comprehensive end-to-end solution from development to deployment and growth.
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Developer-focused / Industry Leader
